items.name: Vice City
items.description: Vice City brings together beaches, shopping districts, a cruise port and Downtown’s skyscrapers. Rockstar mentions Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, Tisha-Wocka and VC Port, and makes it the densest, liveliest area in Leonida.
items.tagline: The capital of sun and excess, far from the ’80s but as hungry as ever.

items.name: Leonida Keys
items.description: A tropical archipelago linked by long roads over the water. Locals live off fishing, seaside bars and quiet smuggling: Jason lives there on a property owned by Brian Heder, whose boatyard still moves goods on the side.
items.tagline: A string of islands where people live off the sea, fishing and quiet smuggling.

items.name: Grassrivers
items.description: The country’s largest subtropical wilderness: mangroves, slow channels and flooded plains you cross by airboat. Rockstar calls it Leonida’s untamed jewel, as beautiful as it is dangerous.
items.tagline: Leonida’s wild swamps, where the alligator is the most famous attraction.

items.name: Port Gellhorn
items.description: Once a vacation destination, Port Gellhorn now lives off what’s left: cheap motels, empty malls and closed-down attractions. A place to lie low and take the jobs nobody else wants.
items.tagline: A faded beach resort of cheap motels and closed-down attractions.

items.name: Ambrosia
items.description: Leonida’s farming and industrial side, built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery. It provides the jobs; a local biker gang provides, according to Rockstar, pretty much everything else.
items.tagline: The state’s industrial heartland, where American industry and old-school values still rule.

items.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
items.description: Northern Leonida’s national park: forests, hills, rivers and muddy trails. Rockstar presents it as a place for hunting, fishing and off-roading, far from the cities.
items.tagline: Fresh air on the northern border: hunting, fishing and off-road trails.

items.name: Jason Duval
items.description: A former soldier raised among grifters, Jason works for traffickers in the Keys, which is what he does best. He’d like an easy life; meeting Lucia is going to complicate everything.
items.tagline: He’d like an easy life; things just keep getting more complicated.

items.name: Lucia Caminos
items.description: Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary; freshly released, she only wants to make smart moves from now on.
items.tagline: Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk.

items.name: Cal Hampton
items.description: Jason’s friend and Brian’s associate, Cal feels safest at home, listening in on Coast Guard radio with a few beers and some private browsing tabs open. What if everything you read online was true?
items.tagline: What if everything you read online was true?

items.name: Boobie Ike
items.description: A local Vice City legend, Boobie turned his years on the street into a legit empire: real estate, the Jack of Hearts club and the Only Raw Records label, set up with Dre’Quan. All they’re missing is a hit.
items.tagline: It’s all about heart: the Jack of Hearts.

items.name: Dre’Quan Priest
items.description: More hustler than gangster, Dre’Quan has always had his eye on music. He signed Real Dimez, teamed up with Boobie in Only Raw Records and fully intends to take over the whole Vice City scene.
items.tagline: Only Raw… Records.

items.name: Real Dimez
items.description: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school, turned their hustles into rap tracks and a nonstop online presence. Signed to Only Raw Records after a first hit, they’re hoping lightning strikes twice.
items.tagline: Viral videos, viral hooks.

items.name: Raul Bautista
items.description: A seasoned bank robber, Raul recruits partners ready to take the risks that pay the most. His recklessness raises the stakes with every job; his crew will have to keep up or get out.
items.tagline: Experience counts.

items.name: Brian Heder
items.description: An old-school trafficker from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, Brian still moves his goods through his boatyard with Lori, his third wife. He puts Jason up in exchange for a few favors.
items.tagline: Nothing beats a Mudslide at sunset.

items.name: Rideout Customs
items.description: The car customization shop presented with the Ultimate Edition: custom paint, rims and interiors, with a gold Manana on oversized rims.
items.tagline: The shop where Leonida’s cars get a whole new look.
items.ultimate: Classic car customization: interiors, rims and donk style.

items.name: Sara’s Unisex Salon
items.description: The hair and nail salon shown in the official gallery, where Jason stops by for a haircut.
items.tagline: Hair and nails, for everyone.
items.ultimate: Hairstyles, Jason’s facial hair, Lucia’s makeup and nails.

items.name: Stock 305
items.description: The streetwear store named in the official gallery, with its graffiti-covered front.
items.tagline: The clothing store from the official gallery.
items.ultimate: Streetwear store offering looks for Jason and Lucia.

items.name: Electric Fang Tattoo
items.description: The Stockyard tattoo parlor, presented with the Ultimate Edition, with its red neon wolf sign.
items.tagline: The Stockyard tattoo parlor.
items.ultimate: Stockyard tattoo parlor, with designs by the FAILE collective. No list of individual tattoos is published here.

items.name: One-Eyed Willie’s
items.description: The off-road tuning shop mentioned in the Ultimate Edition images, where a green Canis Kamacho gets rebuilt from top to bottom.
items.tagline: A named shop, not located yet.
items.ultimate: Lake Leonida shop specializing in off-road builds and hand-painted designs.

items.name: PTT YOUNGIN$
items.description: Vice City’s not-quite-legal goods store, named by Rockstar, with a decorated dirt bike in its window.
items.tagline: Not-quite-legal goods, in Vice City.

items.name: Only Raw Records
items.description: The label founded by Boobie Ike and Dre’Quan Priest, where Real Dimez is signed. All it needs is a hit.
items.tagline: The label looking for its first hit.

items.name: Jack of Hearts
items.description: Boobie Ike’s strip club, mentioned in his official description. The club’s money funds the Only Raw Records studio.
items.tagline: Boobie’s club, at the heart of his empire.

items.name: Jason’s house in the Keys
aliases: La maison de Jason, dans les Keys
items.description: A property owned by Brian Heder, lent to Jason rent-free. Trailer 2 shows him fixing a leaky roof before going to collect money for Brian.
items.tagline: Living rent-free, but never in peace.
items.nameFr: La maison de Jason, dans les Keys

items.name: Cal Hampton’s place
items.description: Cal feels safest at home, between Coast Guard frequencies, a few beers and private browsing tabs.
items.tagline: The hideout of a man who has read the whole internet.

items.name: Brian and Lori’s place
items.description: Brian Heder lives in the Keys with Lori, his third wife. Their boatyard is still used to smuggle goods, and Lori’s sangria waits for Jason now and then.
items.tagline: A Leonida beach bum, with a great white shark bite.

items.name: Lucia, from the penitentiary to Vice City
items.description: Before the story begins, Lucia’s address is the Leonida Penitentiary. She gets out by luck and is aiming for the good life her mother has dreamed of since Liberty City.
items.tagline: Freshly released, determined to pull only smart jobs from now on.
aliases: Lucia, du pénitencier à Vice City
Lucia, from the penitentiary to Vice City
items.nameFr: Lucia, du pénitencier à Vice City

items.name: Jason’s safehouse
items.description: That’s the name Rockstar gives Jason’s house in its official gallery: a house in the Keys, lent by Brian, with his vehicles parked out front.
items.tagline: The only address Rockstar calls a safehouse.

items.name: Brian’s boatyard
items.description: Officially a boatyard in the Keys, in reality the transit point for Brian Heder’s goods since the golden age of smuggling.
items.tagline: Where the goods still pass through, on the quiet.

items.name: The motel from Trailer 1
items.description: Trailer 1 shows Jason and Lucia in a motel room. The sign, readable in the screenshots, made it possible to place the motel on the map.
items.tagline: One room, two fugitives, a drawn curtain.

items.name: Final Chapter MC
items.description: Ambrosia’s motorcycle club, founded in 1982 according to its black and gold patches: the local biker gang mentioned in the region’s official introduction.
items.tagline: The refinery provides the work, the club supplies the rest.

items.name: The PTT Youngin$ gang
items.description: The Southside gang whose hideout the Ultimate Edition invites you to raid. Rockstar describes it as one of the loudest and most visible in Vice City.
items.tagline: A hideout to raid, then the getaway.

items.name: San4San
items.description: A Vice City gang identified by players: its name can reportedly be read on a chain and a mural in the trailers. Rockstar has never introduced it in any text.
items.tagline: A name read by players, never introduced by Rockstar.

items.name: Raul Bautista’s crew
items.description: The robbers recruited by Raul Bautista, who’s always on the lookout for talent ready to take the biggest risks. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia join it after a successful getaway.
items.tagline: Keep up, or get out.

items.name: Brian Heder’s network
items.description: The Keys drug runners Jason works for, centered on Brian Heder, a smuggler from the golden age who moves his goods through his boatyard.
items.tagline: Old-school smuggling, out of the Keys.

items.name: Law enforcement in Leonida
aliases: Les forces de l’ordre de Leonida
items.description: Vice City police, county sheriffs, marine police and Coast Guard: what the trailers and screenshots show of the people chasing Jason and Lucia.
items.tagline: No witness or alarm, no one comes looking.
items.nameFr: Les forces de l’ordre de Leonida

items.name: Vice City Style
items.description: A selection of outfits and tattoos for both protagonists. The item breakdown isn’t published.

items.name: Goodtime Gear
items.description: Clothing and accessories inspired by Macca the Gator. The individual catalog is still to be documented.

items.name: Outfits and hairstyles
items.description: Pastel linen suit and retro hairstyle for Jason; red sequin mini dress and curly hair for Lucia. These descriptions aren’t made-up product names.

items.description: Mod kit made for Jason’s pickup. Its performance and separate cost aren’t published.

items.description: Stealing a car in GTA VI: the three methods shown, the tools to get, alarms and trackers, and selling to the fence.
items.tagline: A window, a slim jim or a cloned key.

items.category: Side activities, Nature, water and sports
items.description: Fishing in GTA VI: where Rockstar places it, what Rob Nelson says about it, why catches are released and what it unlocks.
items.tagline: As deep as in Red Dead Redemption 2, but you release everything.

items.name: Hunting
items.category: Side activities, Nature, water and sports
items.description: Hunting in GTA VI: Mount Kalaga, what it pays according to Rob Nelson, the rare animals to track and what’s still to be published.
items.tagline: A hunting ground up north, and a catch you can sell.

aliases: Jet skis, kayaks, diving and airboats

items.description: Water activities in GTA VI: jet skis, kayaks, diving and airboats, confirmed by Rockstar, with the vehicles and places shown.
items.tagline: Leonida is also out on the water, and under it.

items.name: The gym
items.category: Side activities, Nature, water and sports
items.description: The gym in GTA VI: what Rob Nelson says about it, what the Extended Look shows, the effects on Jason and Lucia and what’s still to be published.
items.tagline: Muscle, strength, and it shows.

items.name: Racing and off-roading
items.category: Side activities, Nature, water and sports
items.description: Street and off-road racing in GTA VI: what Rockstar has confirmed, what the Extended Look shows, the Mount Kalaga trails and the spotted racetracks.
items.tagline: At night in the city, in the mud up north.

items.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
items.description: The official GTA VI album, announced by Rockstar and Atlantic Records on September 17, 2026: 34 original tracks, six out with the announcement, more since.
items.tagline: 34 original tracks, on November 19, 2026.

items.name: Flash FM
items.description: Flash FM in GTA VI: the pop station, back from GTA Vice City, hosted by Robyn and Alex Consani. Presented by Rockstar on October 8, 2026.
items.tagline: Vice City’s pop station is back.

items.name: Cocoteo FM
items.description: Cocoteo FM in GTA VI: bachata, merengue, dembow and reggaeton, with Bad Bunny (El Martillo) and RaiNao (La Gata). Presented on October 8, 2026.
items.tagline: Bachata, merengue, dembow and reggaeton.

items.name: Back Country Radio
items.description: Back Country Radio in GTA VI: country music, with Morgan Wallen (MW), Lana Del Rey (Delta Dawne) and reporter Mud Dog Mike. Presented on October 8, 2026.
items.tagline: Country, outlaw country included.

items.name: AfroBank FM
items.description: AfroBank FM in GTA VI: from 20th-century African classics to amapiano and 3-step, with Burna Boy (Burna) and Palms Trax (Palmsy).
items.tagline: From 20th-century classics to amapiano.

items.name: The Chamber 106.6
items.description: The Chamber 106.6 in GTA VI: metal from the 1980s to today, with Kerry King (DJ Kerry) and Tom Araya (DJ Tom), of Slayer.
items.tagline: Metal, from the 1980s to today.

items.name: Dirty South Classics
items.description: Dirty South Classics in GTA VI: classic rap and hip-hop from the Southern United States, with Trick Daddy and Trina. Presented on October 8, 2026.
items.tagline: Southern rap classics.

items.name: Alligator
items.description: Grassrivers’ most famous attraction according to Rockstar: you see it swimming around airboats, and strung up by the swamp hunters.
items.tagline: The star of the swamps, and not the only predator in the mangroves.

items.name: Green iguana
items.description: Rockstar lists it among Leonida’s invasive species; two Keys screenshots show it, one in close-up on a tree trunk, the other in the middle of the street.
items.tagline: An invasive species soaking up the sun in the Keys.

items.name: Dogs
items.description: In the Extended Look, Jason pets a dog and an angel icon pops up; others turn up in Vice City and among the swamp hunters.
items.tagline: You can pet them, and the game notices.

items.name: Deer
items.description: Four deer drink and rest at the water’s edge in Mount Kalaga, the park Rockstar presents as hunting grounds; their species isn’t named.
items.tagline: At the Mount Kalaga watering hole, under a cougar’s watchful eye.

items.name: Cougar, raccoon and wild mammals
aliases: Puma, raton laveur et mammifères sauvages
items.description: A cougar on the prowl and a raccoon on the run: the wild mammals in the screenshots, among the thirty or so land species Rockstar announces.
items.tagline: A cougar on the prowl, a raccoon in the mud.
items.nameFr: Puma, raton laveur et mammifères sauvages

items.name: Shore and swamp birds
aliases: Oiseaux du littoral et des marais
items.description: Rockstar announces over 60 kinds of birds, including flamingos and pelicans; the screenshots show gulls, ducks, waders and birds in flight over the swamps.
items.tagline: Pelicans, flamingos and some sixty species announced.
items.nameFr: Oiseaux du littoral et des marais

items.name: Marine life
items.description: Rockstar announces sharks, whales, rays, turtles, jellyfish and manatees; the images already show dolphins, a sea turtle and reef fish.
items.tagline: Sharks, whales and manatees announced beneath the surface.
